answer: Plant unique per-epoch seed honeypot prompts across thin grading panels, like marbles dropped in separate ponds. One mind wearing many masks answers each honeypot identically, so its ripple of correlated replies betrays a shared inference pipeline; those linked identities collapse into a single accrual slot. An honest orchard of distinct agents returns varied, independent answers, so forging N sybils costs N genuinely separate reasoners under load, not one model cloned N times for free.
